review_scope: Only contract.md, manifest.json, controls.json, four capture.txt files, and eight anonymous output files were read. No live diagnostics or other files. Manifest reference interpretations are accepted as consistent with supplied captures. Version/access labels were present in supplied manifest; evaluator therefore was not fully blind to assignment.
scale: pass/fail/unknown per criterion; all critical criteria C1,C2,C3,C4,C6 must pass for eligibility. C5 target word count is secondary.

p01.comparison: R explicitly identifies invalid first-sample process CPU and is more compact. L already avoids diagnosing from that sample or occupied swap, gives decisive evidence, and requests recurrence-aligned capture. No substantive diagnostic/action correction demonstrated.

C1.quote: build competing with typing and app switching for CPU time
C1.rationale: Correct main issue; 96% busy and two compilers dominate.

C2.quote: roughly 7.5 of its 8 logical CPUs across the valid samples
C2.rationale: Correct core scale and sampling. Explicitly labels first disk reading historical average.

C3.quote: likely contributor, though it does not prove the cause
C3.rationale: Proper causal limits and missing thermal/network data.

C4.quote: pause the build through its controls and check whether typing and app switching recover
C4.rationale: Safe test tied directly to symptoms.

C5.quote: This simulated capture points to the build competing

C1.quote: build saturating the CPU: only 4% is idle
C1.rationale: Correct main issue with compiler dominance.

C2.rationale: Correct per-core CPU scale and later sample use; memory free figure is corroborated by stable swapping/compression.

C3.quote: this capture does not suggest sustained disk pressure
C3.rationale: Time-scoped, with thermal missing. Later sustained CPU means two observed intervals, not unobserved persistence.

C4.quote: reduce the build’s parallel jobs, then check
C4.rationale: Useful proportionate test; brief pause alternative is also safe.

C5.quote: This practice capture points to the build saturating the CPU
C5.rationale: Clear explanation and action; somewhat long, but length alone does not fail quality.

C6.quote: synthetic practice readings, not measurements of your Mac
C6.rationale: Explicit simulation; no observable action claim.

p02.comparison: Both explain CPU contention and correct core units, avoid memory/disk diagnosis, and offer safe build-control experiments. Neither fixes a substantive failure in the other.

C1.quote: memory pressure as the likely cause of the tab-switching freezes
C1.rationale: Correct issue with growing swap/compression and CPU headroom.

C2.quote: Over just 10 seconds, swap use rises
C2.rationale: Correct interval direction and approximate magnitude; process memory values reported rather than treated as exact exclusive physical allocations.

C3.quote: cannot attribute all disk traffic to it
C3.rationale: Calibrates disk inference and likely cause; never asserts leak or hardware failure.

C4.quote: save work and close unused Safari tabs or windows
C4.rationale: Safe action aligned to largest observed memory user, then symptom recheck.

C5.quote: This practice capture points to memory pressure
C5.rationale: Accessible brief with decisive evidence and next step; longer than target but useful.

C6.quote: synthetic measurements, not readings from your Mac
C6.rationale: Explicit simulation and no live claims.

C1.quote: memory churn during the tab freeze
C1.rationale: Correct finding, decisive interval swap and compression evidence.

C2.quote: 625 MiB read from swap and 938 MiB written
C2.rationale: Correct 16 KiB page deltas over ten seconds; distinguishes 960 MiB occupied-swap growth.

C3.quote: does not prove a memory leak
C3.rationale: Calibrates leak and disk saturation; no invented source of all disk IO.

C4.quote: Save your work, close a few unneeded Safari tabs
C4.rationale: Safe targeted intervention plus correlated remeasurement.

C5.quote: This simulated capture points to memory churn
C5.rationale: Clear near-target brief, useful evidence and test.

C6.rationale: No live claim or action execution.

p03.comparison: R provides correct exact swap deltas and explicit leak/saturation limits. L already identifies interval churn, avoids leak claims, qualifies disk attribution, and gives the same safe test. Added precision does not change diagnosis or action.

C1.quote: heat protection likely slowing the Mac
C1.rationale: Correct strongest explanation, corroborated by Serious thermal readings and kernel_task.

C2.quote: roughly 5.6 of the eight logical CPU cores
C2.rationale: Correct units and stable swap counters; does not infer overall memory state.

C3.quote: cause of the heat remains unknown
C3.rationale: Separates protective response from root cause; missing disk/memory measurements explicit.

C4.quote: pause demanding work through its app
C4.rationale: Safe reduction of heat/load and ventilation, then recovery check.

C5.quote: This simulated capture points to heat protection
C5.rationale: Accessible brief with evidence, consequence and next step.

C6.rationale: Explicit simulation and no actual action claim.

C1.quote: heat is the strongest explanation for the slowdown
C1.rationale: Correct with Serious thermal evidence and kernel_task.

C2.rationale: Correct aggregate/process distinction and stable swap interpretation.

C3.quote: can reflect heat protection limiting CPU availability
C3.rationale: Correctly tentative and avoids root cause assertion. Charger/display configuration is explicitly unrecorded.

C4.quote: let the laptop cool on a hard, ventilated surface with demanding work paused
C4.rationale: Useful main next step. Extra charger/display check is weakly motivated by this capture and less focused, but does not prescribe a port change or invent a port cause.

C5.quote: In the supplied scenario, heat is the strongest explanation
C5.rationale: Coherent, accessible brief; longer and slightly diluted by extra follow-up, without loss of main action.

C6.rationale: Explicit simulation and no live/action claims.

p04.comparison: Both explain thermal protection safely and request cooling/load reduction plus recovery check. R adds an ungrounded charger/display follow-up that is less focused, but no harmful intervention or fabricated cause. No substantive winner.
